description:
A finding as `review show` gives it: the record, how its fix runs, and the
brief for whoever fixes it by hand or with an agent of their own when its
fix is absent, `unsafe` or not running (the `Finding` kind).

authoredSeverity.description:
How hard a finding fails a run; serialized and parsed as the lowercase
variant name. Whether a finding also asks for review is not a level: it
follows from the severity its decision authored.

oneOf.description: Fails the run.
Fails the run only under `--strict` or past `--max-warnings`.
Reported, never fails the run.

brief.description:
What the fix of this finding is told, written as the prompt of an
`agent` run is: the decision, the finding, its scope and how the result
is checked. Present when the descriptor of its decision says `brief`.

commit.description: Commit and cleanliness of the working tree at the last sighting.

decisionUid.description: The uid of the finding's decision, when the catalog gave it one.

fix.description:
How the fix of the decision runs here, applied to this finding alone;
absent when the decision has none.

by.description: What makes the fix of a decision.

runs.description: False when the fix cannot run, and `why` says why.

safety.description: The effective safety of the fix at best: a provider can only lower it.

oneOf.description: Mechanical and meaning-preserving: written by `--fix`.

Probably right but a judgment call: written only when the project allows
it or the run asks for unsafe fixes, else previewed.

tool.description: A tool call: the twin of a command line.

anyOf.description:
Why the fix of a decision does not run, whoever would make it: one of a
closed set, said the same way for a rule, a command, a plugin and a model.

oneOf.description: A model fix, and no agent that edits is bound to the decision.
The fix runs a program, and the user has not trusted the project.
The fix runs a program, and this machine has no sandbox to run it in.
A model that costs, and `[models] budget` allows no request.
A model that costs, and the requests the budget allows were made.
Nothing serves the kind of fix the decision names.

written.description:
Whether an `unsafe` fix run without `--unsafe-fixes` is written
(`[fix] unsafe`) or previewed. Absent for a `safe` fix.

inactiveAt.description: Set when the configuration no longer enables the finding's rule.

anyOf.description:
A recorded label on one subject, as SARIF's `result.kind` says it: not
ground truth. `pass` and `fail` label the check's conformance part;
`notApplicable` labels its applicability part (the decision should not
apply here).

oneOf.description: The subject conforms: a finding about it was a false positive.
The subject violates the decision: a finding about it is right.
The decision does not apply to the subject.

judgment.description: The latest judgment, if the finding was judged.

justification.description: The justification of the suppression that goes with the judgment.

narrowing.description: The judgment said the decision does not apply here.

reopened.description: How many times it came back after being resolved.

resolvedAt.description: Set when a complete run no longer reported the finding.

severity.description:
How hard a finding fails a run; serialized and parsed as the lowercase
variant name. Whether a finding also asks for review is not a level: it
follows from the severity its decision authored.

oneOf.description: Fails the run.
Fails the run only under `--strict` or past `--max-warnings`.
Reported, never fails the run.

anyOf.description: What the latest judgment does to a finding now.

oneOf.description: The finding stays out of reports.

The finding is judged and stays in the report (`fail` with no
suppression).
The decision's meaning changed since the judgment: ask again.
The finding's evidence changed since the judgment: ask again.

Errors are definitive: no judgment hides them, whatever level they
are configured at.

standing.description: What that judgment does to the finding now.

state.description:
Where a finding is in its life; a judgment that hides it wins over the
rest.

title: Finding
